vocabulary.definition: people who move to a new area to live and establish homes
vocabulary.example: The early settlers arrived in covered wagons seeking new opportunities.

vocabulary.definition: to add or attach a territory to a larger political entity
vocabulary.example: The neighboring island was annexed by the country for strategic reasons.
The boundaries of the national park were poorly defined, leading to disputes with neighboring landowners.

vocabulary.definition: to prove more powerful or superior
vocabulary.example: After a long legal battle, justice finally prevails and the innocent man is set free.

vocabulary.definition: people who are the first to settle in a new area
vocabulary.example: The pioneers braved harsh conditions to establish a new community in the wild west.
